prompt: What legal document allows an ALR-suspended driver to operate a vehicle for work or essential family needs?

options.text: An informal written authorization letter signed by their primary employer
An Occupational Driver License (ODL), granted by court order for essential needs
A temporary commercial vehicle registration sticker attached to bumper
A notarized affidavit from an immediate family member verifying hardship
